Production that runs itself. P r o d u c t i o n t h a t r u n s i t s e l f . The autonomous system for production that diagnoses, fixes, and prevents issues across your environment. Book a Demo Antimetal’s app with its chat open. Asked for the latest issue to pay attention to, Antimetal opens ISS-2, checkout failing 0.9% of requests since a deploy, and drafts a one-line fix. The fix is applied, and an observer is added to the world model to watch checkout errors. The app’s nav shows each of its pages. Why is checkout slower? 7 Patrols running 5 Errors found $ 1,200 Savings 24 Events Today’s issues 3 Checkout failing 0.9% of requests since deploy v3.2.1 ISS-2 + 3 0.9% of checkout requests have failed since deploy v3.2.1 rolled out at 02:00, up from 0.2% before it.
